profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years of software development experience seeking opportunities to grow and challenge myself. Innovative, detail-oriented, and self-driven individual with a passion for systems design and machine learning applications.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed internal tools for machine communication, sensor data capturing, data analysis, and on-the-fly model training/testing using value and image features to classify denominations and detect counterfeits with high accuracy.
• Designed and implemented a session-driven application framework with change management.
• Mentored intern to implement embedded C++ imaging sensor diagnostics tool.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led high-speed, imaging sensor calibration research project to production consisting of a multi-platform solution to optimize image capturing and processing for diverse substrates.
• Enabled C# application to manage connections to multiple devices with new communication protocol that improved status synchronization, connection reliability, data transmission, and data pre-processing.
• Redesigned C++ currency learning tool allowing user to accomplish data extraction tasks 5x faster.

positions.title: Web Developer / UI Designer
positions.description:
• Created professional websites including their programming content and graphic design
• Developed content includes HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP and database integration
• Created company image, print media, website wireframes/prototypes, and interactive websites

positions.title: Plant Manager / IT Consultant
positions.description:
• Administered, setup, and troubleshot software and hardware on servers and client computers.
• Trained and supervised employees for Accounts Payable/Receivable, and Inventory/Store Management.
• Managed 4-6 manufacturing employees while monitoring, calculating, and predicting daily production.

volunteerExperiences.description: Tutored college students on Pre-Algebra, Algebra and Calculus material.
Participated in multiple initiatives around education and awareness on intersectionality, career growth, and mental health.

projects.title: Senior Design (Automatic Airflow Register)
projects.description:
• Conceptualized and developed energy-saving, wireless temperature control system for HVAC register
• Implemented ZigBee technology and sensors in a microcontroller-based system programmed in C

projects.title: Robotics Java Project (Wii Rovio)
projects.description:
• Engineered Java program to function as the Control unit for Wii Remote and Rovio using accelerometer and button listeners, Bluetooth connectivity and HTTP commands using CGI
• Programmed Wii Remote to control Rovio (wireless robot) using motion sensors and adv. commands
